findings.message: `proj.web.trends` is partitioned by `refresh_date`, but the query doesn't filter on it, so it reads every partition (3.2 GB in all). The filter on `week` doesn't limit which partitions are read.
findings.fix: Add a filter on `refresh_date`, for example `refresh_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)`.
